elaine: Heads-up — the int4 candidate we staged hit our smoke, but cold-start tails are higher than baseline. posting quick checklist to decide whether to re-run promote or hold. :warning:
jorge: Ugh. numbers?
elaine: p50 ~ same, p95 +10ms, p99 +120ms on cold path (coldstart requests). warm requests look identical. kv-cache hit rate down from 87% -> 62% during the run.
ryan: That kv hit drop is suspicious — did the staging slice use the same session affinity?
elaine: Yes, we pinned session hash. config used: ```route: /v1/generate
model: rwd-v2p1-int4
affinity: session_hash
promote_mode: staged
```
arun: Any change to kv key formatting after quantization? sometimes tokenization differences change prefix lengths and cache keys.
jorge: Good call. I looked at a few traces — requests with long system prompts show more misses. maybe quantization changed tokenizer offsets?
elaine: Could be. Also saw a small bump in cold memory allocations (OOM falls back counts +2).
ryan: Proposed checklist before re-run promote:
- confirm tokenization parity between fp16 and int4 builds (hashes for sample prompts)
- run `promote-tool --dry-run --slice=coldpath --samples=200` to surface cold-start KV misses
- collect per-shard kv warmup logs (`/var/log/serve/kv_warm.log`) and grep for `miss` count
- run a controlled cold-start smoke with identical concurrency to production (use `loadtest --ramp 0 --concurrency 1`)
- compare cpu/gpu mem maps during warmup (`nvidia-smi dmon` + `top`)
- if misses > 20% vs baseline, abort promote and snapshot weights + env

arun: I can run the dry-run smoke now. pushing lightweight script to run 200 samples across 10 shards.
elaine: Thanks. also, deploy-bot: please attach the promote run id and config used for the staged run so we can reproduce.
deploy-bot: promote-run 2026-03-21-0912 attached: run_id=pr-6742, config_s3=s3://redwood-promotes/pr-6742/config.json, sample_manifest=s3://redwood-promotes/pr-6742/samples.json
jorge: If this is kv warmup, one mitigation is to add a short soft-warm period where ~5% traffic is routed to the new variant with a `warmup=true` header to seed caches before full increase. but we need to measure how long until hit-rate stabilizes.
ryan: Agreed. Another short-term tactic: enable prefix caching (prefix_len=64) in route config for the staged slice. cheaper than aborting.
elaine: Let's not change config until we confirm. Steps for today:
1) arun runs `promote-tool --dry-run --slice=coldpath --samples=200` and posts results here.
2) jorge will run tokenization parity check across 100 sample prompts and share hashes.
3) i will pull `/var/log/serve/kv_warm.log` from the pr-6742 run and post diff vs last successful promote (pr-6610).
4) if dry-run shows sustained >15% kv miss gap at p95, we abort promote and trigger rollback policy.

arun: running now. ETA ~7m.
jorge: doing tokenization check, will share a small script: ```python
from tokenizer import Tokenizer
base = Tokenizer('rwd-v2p1-fp16')
quant = Tokenizer('rwd-v2p1-int4')
for t in samples[:100]:
    print(t[:80], hash(tuple(base.encode(t))), hash(tuple(quant.encode(t))))
```
elaine: perfect. remember to include long system prompt edge cases.
arun: dry-run finished: summary -> samples=200, cold-kv-miss=38%, baseline=9%, p99-latency increase 130ms. attaching gist: https://gist.internal/smoke/pr-6742-dryrun
ryan: ouch. that's above our abort threshold.
jorge: my tokenization parity check shows 6 mismatches out of 100, mostly prompts with leading whitespace and system delimiters. quant encoder differs on `​` handling.
elaine: that explains kv keys diverging. path forward?
ryan: short-term: abort promote, mark the build as needs-tokenizer-fix. longer-term: add a parser-compat test in pre-promote CI that runs tokenization parity across a corpus.
jorge: i'll open a PR to normalize invisible whitespace in tokenizer and add the CI check.
arun: i'll rollback the staged traffic and run a canary abort. deploy-bot: initiate rollback for pr-6742.
deploy-bot: rollback job submitted (job_id rb-9931). Estimated completion 2m. :white_check_mark:
elaine: thanks team. action items in thread: @jorge PR for tokenizer fix, @arun verify rollback and re-run smoke once fix is merged, @ryan add CI parity test. I'll follow up with an abbreviated postmortem after we get PRs in. :memo:
ryan: sounds good. one minor ask — can we add a metric to the promote run summary that reports `kv_miss_by_prompt_bucket` so next time we can triage faster?
elaine: yes, filing a tiny ticket for that. done. https://issues.internal/RED-ml-2241
jorge: ok i'll include a testcase for long system prompts.
elaine: closing for now — rollback done, we won't re-run promote until tokenizer fix is validated. :lock:
